 227    #==================================
 228    # SORTING FUNCTIONS
 229    #==================================
 230
 231    class SortingFunctions:
 232        """
 233        Functions to sort cardlists.
 234        Each cardlist is: [(RenderableCard (Class), amount)]
 235        """
 236
 237        @staticmethod
 238        def no_order(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 239            """
 240            Returns the cardlist in the same order as
 241            it was before.
 242            """
 243            return cardlist
 244
 245        @staticmethod
 246        def randomized(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 247            """
 248            Returns the cardlist after a random shuffle.
 249            """
 250            cardlist_copy = cardlist.copy()
 251            random.shuffle(cardlist_copy)
 252            return cardlist_copy
 253
 254        @staticmethod
 255        def name_descending(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 256            """
 257            Sorts by name descending.
 258            """
 259            clist = cardlist.copy()
 260            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].info().name)
 261            return clist
 262
 263        @staticmethod
 264        def name_ascending(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 265            """
 266            Sorts by name ascending.
 267            """
 268            clist = cardlist.copy()
 269            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].info().name)
 270            clist.reverse()
 271            return clist
 272
 273        @staticmethod
 274        def amount_descending(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 275            """
 276            Sorts by amount descending.
 277            """
 278            clist = cardlist.copy()
 279            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
 280            return clist
 281
 282        @staticmethod
 283        def amount_ascending(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 284            """
 285            Sorts by amount ascending.
 286            """
 287            clist = cardlist.copy()
 288            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
 289            clist.reverse()
 290            return clist

 297    class FocusedTextInputFrame(Frame):
 298        """
 299        Provides a text input frame.
 300        """
 301
 302        TEXT_ENTERED: id_t = R_ID()
 303        ESCAPE: id_t = R_ID()
 304
 305        def __init__(
 306                    self,
 307                    frame_dim: pygame.Rect,
 308                    parent_frame: Frame,
 309                    focus_group: str = "",
 310                    has_focus: bool = True
 311                    ):
 312
 313            #initializing
 314            Frame.__init__(
 315                            self,
 316                            frame_enum=FrameEnums.UNDEFINED,
 317                            data=None,
 318                            frame_dim=frame_dim,
 319                            parent_frame=parent_frame,
 320                            focus_group=focus_group,
 321                            has_focus=has_focus
 322                            )
 323
 324            self.text_input: TextInput = None
 325            """
 326            Text input reference.
 327            """
 328            self.text_input_frame: pygame.Rect = None
 329            """
 330            Frame_dim for self.text_input.
 331            """
 332            self.background_color: color_t = Colors.BLACK
 333            """
 334            Background color.
 335            """
 336            self.background_alpha: int = 127
 337            """
 338            Alpha value for the background.
 339            """
 340            self.escape_released: bool = False
 341            """
 342            For checking if escaping the frame is possible.
 343            """
 344            self._exit_type: id_t = None
 345            """
 346            The state describing how the frame was exited.
 347            """
 348            self.intro_delay: float = 100#ms
 349            """
 350            The intro delay.
 351            """
 352            self.intro_delay_clock: Clock = Clock()
 353            """
 354            Intro delay clock.
 355            """
 356
 357            self.rerender()
 358
 359        @override
 360        def rerender(self) -> None:
 361            """
 362            Rerendering.
 363            """
 364            self.text_input_frame = pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width//2, self.height//10)
 365            xc, yc = graphics.get_center_with_rect(self.frame_dim, self.text_input_frame)
 366            #setting the centered position
 367            self.text_input_frame.x = xc
 368            self.text_input_frame.y = yc
 369            #creating the text input
 370            self.text_input = TextInput(
 371                                        self.text_input_frame,
 372                                        focus_group=self.focus_group,
 373                                        has_focus=True #starts out with focus
 374                                        )
 375
 376            self.raise_prerender_flag()
 377            self.intro_delay_clock.start()
 378
 379        @override
 380        def prerender(self) -> None:
 381            """
 382            Prerendering.
 383            """
 384            self.surface.fill((*self.background_color, self.background_alpha))
 385            self.text_input.render(self.surface)
 386
 387        def set_input_text(self, text: str = "") -> None:
 388            """
 389            Sets the text for self.input_text_frame.
 390            """
 391            self.text_input.set_text(text)
 392
 393        def get_input_text(self) -> str:
 394            """
 395            Returns the text of self.text_input.
 396            """
 397            return self.text_input.get_text()
 398
 399        def reset_exit_type(self) -> None:
 400            """
 401            Resets the exit type.
 402            """
 403            self._exit_type = None
 404
 405        def exit_with_enter(self) -> bool:
 406            """
 407            Is true if this frame exited with an enter pressed.
 408            """
 409            return (self._exit_type == RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.TEXT_ENTERED)
 410
 411        def exit_with_escape(self) -> bool:
 412            """
 413            Is true if this frame was aborted.
 414            """
 415            return (self._exit_type == RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.ESCAPE)
 416
 417        @override
 418        def tick(self) -> None:
 419            """
 420            Tick function.
 421            """
 422
 423            if self.intro_delay_clock.elapsed() > self.intro_delay:
 424                self.manage_pygame_events()
 425
 426            ret: Frame = self.text_input.tick()
 427            #polling textinput events
 428            for event in self.text_input.poll_events():
 429
 430                #propagating events
 431                self.push_event(event)
 432
 433                if event.type == TextInput.EventTypes.TEXT_ENTERED:
 434                    self._exit_type = RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.TEXT_ENTERED
 435                    self.raise_exit_flag()
 436
 437            if self.exit_flag_raised():
 438                return None
 439
 440            if self.is_focused():
 441                #checking for any movement key
 442                if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LEFT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.LEFT_ALTERNATIVE)\
 443                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RIGHT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.RIGHT_ALTERNATIVE)\
 444                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_UP) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.UP_ALTERNATIVE)\
 445                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_DOWN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.DOWN_ALTERNATIVE):
 446
 447                    self.text_input.focus()
 448
 449                if (self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY) or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE)) and self.escape_released:
 450                    self._exit_type = RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.ESCAPE
 451                    self.raise_exit_flag()
 452
 453                if not (self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY) and self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE)) and not self.escape_released:
 454                    self.escape_released = True
 455
 456            if not self.text_input.is_focused() and not self.is_focused():
 457                self.focus()
 458                self.escape_released = False
 459
 460            if self.text_input.is_focused():
 461                self.raise_prerender_flag()
 462
 463            if self.prerender_flag_raised():
 464                self.prerender()
 465                self.reset_prerender_flag()
 466
 467            return self

1402    #==================================
1403    # VALIDITY CHECKS
1404    #==================================
1405
1406    def _check_validity(self) -> None:
1407        """
1408        Checks the validity of the own variables.
1409        """
1410        if len(self.groups) == 0:
1411            raise RuntimeError("You need at least one group")
1412        if len(self.groups) - 1 > self.max_group_number: #-1 for full_cardlist
1413            raise RuntimeError("Too many groups. Adjust your max_group_size")
1414        if self.cards_per_line <= 0 or self.cards_per_column <= 0:
1415            raise RuntimeError("cards_per_line and cards_per_column have to be greater than 0")
1416
1417        #checking the group and full cardlists consistency.
1418        #if the group has a cardclass where the amount is greater than the full cardlist
1419        #and is no copylist, its invalid.
1420
1421        for (groupname, group) in self.groups.items():
1422
1423            #checking if it is copylist
1424            is_copylist: bool = Cardgroup.is_copylist(group=group)
1425            if is_copylist:
1426                #skip copylists
1427                continue
1428
1429            #otherwise, check amounts
1430            cardlist: cardlist_t = Cardgroup.cardlist(group=group)
1431            for (cardclass, amount) in cardlist.items():
1432
1433                if amount > self.full_cardlist[cardclass]: #a group has more of this card than allowed: error
1434                    raise RuntimeError(
1435                                        f"ERROR:    Group {groupname} has more copies of {str(cardclass)} than the full cardlist.\n"\
1436                                        f"          {groupname}: {str(amount)} > full_cardlist: {str(self.full_cardlist[cardclass])}"
1437                                        )
1438
1439        #no error, groups were valid
1440
1441    #==================================
1442    # RENDERING
1443    #==================================
1444
1445    @override
1446    def rerender(self) -> None:
1447        """
1448        Rerendering
1449        """
1450
1451        """
1452        VALIDITY CHECK
1453        """
1454        self._check_validity()
1455
1456        """
1457        INFO TEXT
1458        """
1459
1460        iheight: int = int(self.height * self.info_text_vlen_p)
1461
1462        self.info_text_frame = pygame.Rect( 0,
1463                                            self.height - iheight,
1464                                            int(self.width * self.info_text_hlen_p),
1465                                            iheight
1466                                            )
1467
1468        self.info_text_surface = pygame.Surface((self.info_text_frame.width, self.info_text_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1469        self.info_text_rendered = None
1470
1471        """
1472        FULL FRAME + BORDER FRAME
1473        """
1474
1475        #resetting card index
1476        self.selected_card_index = 0
1477        #creating the full image surface
1478        self.full_image_surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1479        #getting border width and height
1480        self.border_width = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.width)
1481        self.border_height = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.height)
1482        #the inner area is the frame inside without the border
1483        self.inner_area = pygame.Rect(
1484                                        self.x + self.border_width,
1485                                        self.y + self.border_height,
1486                                        self.width - 2*self.border_width,
1487                                        self.height - 2*self.border_height
1488
1489                                        )
1490        relative_inner_frame_dim = graphics.position_relative(anchor_rect=self.frame_dim, make_relative_rect=self.inner_area)
1491        #popup frame
1492        self.popup_frame_dim = graphics.apply_margins(relative_inner_frame_dim, self.popup_hmargin, self.popup_vmargin)
1493        #calculating actual border outline sizes
1494        self.border_outline_width = int(self.border_width * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
1495        self.border_outline_height = int(self.border_height * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
1496        #selecting
1497        self.used_border_outline_size = min(self.border_outline_width, self.border_outline_height)
1498        #the inner border corners
1499        self.inner_border_corners = [
1500                                    (self.border_width-self.used_border_outline_size, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
1501                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
1502                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.height - self.border_height + self.used_border_outline_size),
1503                                    (self.border_width - self.used_border_outline_size, self.height - self.border_height)
1504                                    ]
1505        #(rect, color)
1506        self.border_lines = [
1507                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
1508                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_width, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
1509                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
1510                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_height, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
1511
1512                                #outer outline
1513                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
1514                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_outline_width, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
1515                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
1516                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_outline_height, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color)
1517
1518                                #inner outline will be calculated
1519                            ]
1520
1521        #helper function, connects the inner border corners
1522        def rs(p1: point_t, p2: point_t) -> pygame.Rect:
1523            """
1524            This inner function calculates
1525            the rectangles for the inner outline.
1526            """
1527
1528            x: int = p1[0]
1529            y: int = p1[1]
1530            #x and y of the first point
1531
1532            w: int = p2[0] - p1[0]
1533            if w == 0:
1534                w = self.used_border_outline_size
1535
1536            h: int = p2[1] - p1[1]
1537            if h == 0:
1538                h = self.used_border_outline_size
1539
1540            if w < 0 or h < 0:
1541
1542                x = p2[0]
1543                y = p2[1]
1544
1545                w = p1[0] - p2[0]
1546                if w == 0:
1547                    w = self.used_border_outline_size
1548
1549                h = p1[1] - p2[1]
1550                if h == 0:
1551                    h = self.used_border_outline_size
1552
1553            #x, y are the top left, w and h the width
1554            #if any of the width or height are the same,
1555            #they are on top of each other and need to be
1556            #expanded by the used border outline size
1557
1558            return pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)
1559
1560        #creating the render rectangles
1561        for i in range(len(self.inner_border_corners)+1):
1562            #wrap around by one to connect the last point with the first
1563
1564            i1: int = i % len(self.inner_border_corners)
1565            i2: int = (i+1) % len(self.inner_border_corners)
1566            #indices
1567            p1: point_t = None #the first point
1568            p2: point_t = None #the second point
1569            p1, p2 = self.inner_border_corners[i1], self.inner_border_corners[i2]
1570            #constructing and adding a rect to the border lines.
1571            self.border_lines.append((rs(p1, p2), self.border_frame_outline_color))
1572
1573        """
1574        MENU LABEL AND INNER MENU LABEL
1575        """
1576        self.menu_label_height = int(self.inner_area.height * self.menu_label_vmargin)
1577        self.menu_label_surface = pygame.Surface((self.inner_area.width, self.menu_label_height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1578        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = self.menu_label_surface.copy()
1579        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
1580        self.menu_label_surface_pos = (self.inner_area.x, self.inner_area.y)
1581        #calculating menu label dimensions
1582        self.menu_label_frame = self.inner_area.copy()
1583        self.menu_label_frame.height = self.menu_label_height
1584        #inner menu label is the label after applying the margins
1585        self.inner_menu_label_frame = self.menu_label_frame.copy()
1586        self.inner_menu_label_frame = graphics.apply_margins(self.inner_menu_label_frame, self.menu_label_inner_hmargin, self.menu_label_inner_vmargin)
1587
1588
1589        """
1590        -----------------------------------------
1591        MENU LABEL WIDGETS
1592        -----------------------------------------
1593        """
1594
1595        #now calculating the menu options
1596        self.menu_button_frame,\
1597        self.deckname_frame,\
1598        self.decksize_frame = graphics.split_rect_horizontally(
1599                                                                    pygame.Rect(
1600                                                                                    self.inner_menu_label_frame.x - self.menu_label_frame.x,
1601                                                                                    self.inner_menu_label_frame.y - self.menu_label_frame.y,
1602                                                                                    self.inner_menu_label_frame.width,
1603                                                                                    self.inner_menu_label_frame.height
1604                                                                    ),
1605
1606                                                                    [
1607                                                                        self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin,
1608                                                                        1.0-(self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin + self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin),
1609                                                                        self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin
1610                                                                    ]
1611                                                                )
1612        #now rendering the menu items
1613        #rendering the menu button
1614        self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered,\
1615        self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position_smoothscale(self.menu_button_unfocused_image, self.menu_button_frame)
1616        self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered,\
1617        self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position_smoothscale(self.menu_button_focused_image, self.menu_button_frame)
1618
1619
1620
1621        """
1622        -----------------------------------------
1623        CARD POSITION CALCULATIONS
1624        -----------------------------------------
1625        """
1626
1627        #getting the inner area for the cardlist
1628        self.main_list_frame = self.inner_area.copy()
1629
1630        self.main_list_frame.y += self.menu_label_frame.height
1631        self.main_list_frame.height -= self.menu_label_frame.height
1632
1633        #getting the inner main list
1634        self.inner_main_list_frame = graphics.apply_margins(self.main_list_frame, self.main_list_hmargin, self.main_list_vmargin)
1635
1636        self.create_dropdown_menu()
1637        #now getting the card positions
1638        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1639
1640        self.key_clock.start()
1641        self.intro_delay_clock.start()
1642        #prerendering
1643        self.raise_prerender_flag()

1685                        else self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered_pos)

1747    def recalculate_main_list_positions(self, keep_current_state: bool = False) -> None:
1748
1749        """
1750        The method to recalculate
1751        the rectangles and positions of the card previews.
1752
1753        if keep_current_state == True,
1754        the cards wont be reloaded, the yscroll will stay the same,
1755        and the selected index will only change if it is invalid.
1756        """
1757        # Keep cached resources when only the group/order changes. They depend
1758        # on the render dimensions, not on the card's screen position.
1759        previous_image_size = (self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
1760        previous_text_size = self._base_text_render_size
1761
1762        #getting the separator width
1763        self.main_list_hseparator_width = int(self.inner_main_list_frame.width * self.main_list_separator_h_percentage)
1764        self.main_list_vseparator_height = int(self.inner_main_list_frame.height * self.main_list_separator_v_percentage)
1765        #getting the remaining width
1766        self.main_list_hseparator_size =  (self.main_list_hseparator_width // (self.cards_per_line-1) if self.cards_per_line > 1 else 0)
1767        self.main_list_vseparator_size = (self.main_list_vseparator_height // (self.cards_per_column-1) if self.cards_per_column > 1 else 0)
1768        #calculating the shown cardsizes
1769        self.main_list_cwidth = (self.inner_main_list_frame.width - self.main_list_hseparator_width) // self.cards_per_line
1770        self.main_list_cheight = (self.inner_main_list_frame.height - self.main_list_vseparator_height) // self.cards_per_column
1771
1772        if not keep_current_state:
1773            gcards = Cardgroup.cardlist(group=self.groups[self.shown_group])
1774            gcards = [(key, value) for key, value in gcards.items()]
1775            self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(gcards)
1776
1777            self.selected_card_index = 0
1778            self.main_list_yscroll = 0
1779
1780        #rendering all cards, and adding their position
1781        self.subtext_width = 0
1782        self.subtext_height = 0
1783        self.cardimage_width = 0
1784        self.cardimage_height = 0
1785        self.main_list_card_height = 0
1786
1787        if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
1788            self.subtext_width = self.main_list_cwidth
1789            self.subtext_height = int(self.main_list_cheight * self.subtext_margin)
1790            self.cardimage_width = self.main_list_cwidth
1791            self.cardimage_height = self.main_list_cheight - self.subtext_height
1792        else:
1793            self.subtext_width = 0
1794            self.subtext_height = 0
1795            self.cardimage_width = self.main_list_cwidth
1796            self.cardimage_height = self.main_list_cheight
1797
1798        # Text surfaces are rendered into the standard text rectangle. During
1799        # the pressed-card animation, the cached result is scaled to the
1800        # animated rectangle instead of being rerendered at every size.
1801        base_text_rect = graphics.apply_margins(
1802            pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height),
1803            self.cardtext_hmargin,
1804            self.cardtext_vmargin
1805        )
1806        self._base_text_render_size = base_text_rect.size
1807
1808        current_image_size = (self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
1809        if previous_image_size != current_image_size:
1810            self.card_render_cache.clear()
1811            self.shadow_render_cache.clear()
1812
1813        if previous_text_size != self._base_text_render_size:
1814            self.text_render_cache.clear()
1815
1816        cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
1817        cy = self.inner_main_list_frame.y + (self.inner_main_list_frame.height // 2 - self.main_list_cheight // 2 if self.cards_per_column == 1 else 0)
1818
1819        main_list_cards_index = 0
1820        count = 0
1821        card_id_index = 0
1822
1823        self.main_list_cards_dict = {}
1824        self.main_list_cards_rects = {}
1825
1826        """
1827        Creating and assigning card previews.
1828        """
1829
1830        for cardclass, amount in self.main_list_cards:
1831
1832            if amount == 0:
1833                main_list_cards_index += 1
1834                continue
1835
1836            if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
1837
1838                img_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy, self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
1839                text_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy + self.cardimage_height, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height)
1840                #applying the margins
1841                text_rect = graphics.apply_margins(text_rect, self.cardtext_hmargin, self.cardtext_vmargin)
1842
1843                if cy not in self.main_list_cards_rects:
1844                    self.main_list_cards_rects[cy] = []
1845
1846                self.main_list_cards_rects[cy].append((card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect))
1847                self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect, cy)
1848
1849                main_list_cards_index += 1
1850                card_id_index += 1
1851
1852                cx += self.main_list_cwidth + self.main_list_hseparator_size
1853
1854                if not (card_id_index) % self.cards_per_line:
1855
1856                    cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
1857                    cy += self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_vseparator_size
1858
1859            elif self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
1860
1861                for cardcp in range(amount):
1862
1863                    img_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy, self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
1864                    text_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy + self.cardimage_height, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height)
1865
1866                    if cy not in self.main_list_cards_rects:
1867                        self.main_list_cards_rects[cy] = []
1868
1869                    self.main_list_cards_rects[cy].append((card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect))
1870                    self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect, cy)
1871
1872                    card_id_index += 1
1873
1874                    cx += self.main_list_cwidth + self.main_list_hseparator_size
1875
1876                    if not (card_id_index) % self.cards_per_line:
1877
1878                        cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
1879                        cy += self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_vseparator_size
1880
1881                main_list_cards_index += 1
1882
1883        self.n_cards_shown = card_id_index
1884        # Dict insertion order follows the ascending row positions generated
1885        # above, so this tuple is sorted and can be searched with bisect.
1886        self.main_list_row_positions = tuple(self.main_list_cards_rects)
1887
1888        #rendering the name
1889        self.create_deckname_text()
1890        #rendering the decksize
1891        self.create_decksize_text()
1892
1893        #checking the selected index
1894        if self.selected_card_index < 0 or self.selected_card_index >= self.n_cards_shown:
1895            self.selected_card_index = 0
1896
1897
1898    def render_list_with_yscroll(self) -> None:
1899        """
1900        Renders only visible card rows and reuses cached image, text, and
1901        shadow surfaces wherever possible.
1902        """
1903        self.rendered_rows = []
1904
1905        row_positions = self.main_list_row_positions
1906        if not row_positions:
1907            return
1908
1909        # Find the first and last rows intersecting the visible list area.
1910        # This avoids scanning every row when the card list is very large.
1911        visible_top = (
1912            self.inner_main_list_frame.y
1913            - self.main_list_yscroll
1914            - self.main_list_cheight
1915        )
1916        visible_bottom = (
1917            self.inner_main_list_frame.bottom
1918            - self.main_list_yscroll
1919        )
1920        first_row = bisect_left(row_positions, visible_top)
1921        after_last_row = bisect_right(row_positions, visible_bottom)
1922
1923        base_image_width = self.cardimage_width
1924        base_image_height = self.cardimage_height
1925
1926        for cy in row_positions[first_row:after_last_row]:
1927            for id_index, main_list_cards_idx, img_rect, text_rect in self.main_list_cards_rects[cy]:
1928                self.rendered_rows.append((cy, id_index, main_list_cards_idx, img_rect, text_rect))
1929                cinfo = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_idx][0].info()
1930
1931                # Cache the image at its normal layout size. Card-press
1932                # animation changes the rectangle every tick, so cache the
1933                # stable base surface and scale that surface for the animation.
1934                image_key = (
1935                    cinfo.card_image_path,
1936                    base_image_width,
1937                    base_image_height
1938                )
1939                cached_image = self.card_render_cache.get(image_key)
1940                if cached_image is None:
1941                    cached_image = graphics.img_load_and_position_smoothscale(
1942                        cinfo.card_image_path,
1943                        pygame.Rect(0, 0, base_image_width, base_image_height)
1944                    )
1945                    self.card_render_cache[image_key] = cached_image
1946                    if len(self.card_render_cache) > self.CARD_IMAGE_CACHE_LIMIT:
1947                        self.card_render_cache.popitem(last=False)
1948                else:
1949                    self.card_render_cache.move_to_end(image_key)
1950
1951                img, base_img_pos = cached_image
1952                img_pos = base_img_pos
1953
1954                if (
1955                    img_rect.width != base_image_width
1956                    or img_rect.height != base_image_height
1957                ) and base_image_width > 0 and base_image_height > 0:
1958                    scale_x = img_rect.width / base_image_width
1959                    scale_y = img_rect.height / base_image_height
1960                    scaled_size = (
1961                        max(1, int(round(img.get_width() * scale_x))),
1962                        max(1, int(round(img.get_height() * scale_y)))
1963                    )
1964                    img = pygame.transform.smoothscale(img, scaled_size)
1965                    img_pos = (
1966                        int(round(base_img_pos[0] * scale_x)),
1967                        int(round(base_img_pos[1] * scale_y))
1968                    )
1969
1970                img_render_pos = (
1971                    img_rect.x + img_pos[0],
1972                    img_rect.y + img_pos[1] + self.main_list_yscroll
1973                )
1974
1975                if (
1976                    self.selected_card_index == id_index
1977                    and self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1978                ):
1979                    # Scale the selected card slightly. Use integer dimensions
1980                    # because pygame.transform.scale expects integer sizes.
1981                    img_x_inc = max(1, int(round(img.get_width() * 0.1)))
1982                    img_y_inc = max(1, int(round(img.get_height() * 0.1)))
1983                    img = pygame.transform.scale(
1984                        img,
1985                        (img.get_width() + img_x_inc, img.get_height() + img_y_inc)
1986                    )
1987                    img_render_pos = (
1988                        img_render_pos[0] - img_x_inc // 2,
1989                        img_render_pos[1] - img_y_inc // 2
1990                    )
1991
1992                shadow_rect = pygame.Rect(
1993                    img_render_pos[0],
1994                    img_render_pos[1],
1995                    img.get_width(),
1996                    img.get_height()
1997                )
1998                shadow_rect.x += int(self.cardshadow_hoffset_p * shadow_rect.width)
1999                shadow_rect.y += int(self.cardshadow_voffset_p * shadow_rect.height)
2000
2001                shadow_color = (
2002                    (*Colors.BLACK, self.cardshadow_alpha)
2003                    if (
2004                        id_index != self.selected_card_index
2005                        or self.state != RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2006                    )
2007                    else (*Colors.YELLOW, self.selected_cardshadow_alpha)
2008                )
2009
2010                # Shadow surfaces are identical for cards with equal size and
2011                # color; reuse them instead of allocating one every frame.
2012                shadow_key = (shadow_rect.size, shadow_color)
2013                shadow_surf = self.shadow_render_cache.get(shadow_key)
2014                if shadow_surf is None:
2015                    shadow_surf = pygame.Surface(shadow_rect.size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
2016                    shadow_surf.fill(shadow_color)
2017                    self.shadow_render_cache[shadow_key] = shadow_surf
2018                    if len(self.shadow_render_cache) > self.SHADOW_CACHE_LIMIT:
2019                        self.shadow_render_cache.popitem(last=False)
2020                else:
2021                    self.shadow_render_cache.move_to_end(shadow_key)
2022
2023                self.surface.blit(shadow_surf, (shadow_rect.x, shadow_rect.y))
2024                self.surface.blit(img, img_render_pos)
2025
2026                card_subtext: str = self.get_card_subtext(
2027                                                            y_position=cy,
2028                                                            id_index=id_index,
2029                                                            main_list_index=main_list_cards_idx,
2030                                                            img_rect=img_rect,
2031                                                            text_rect=text_rect
2032                                                            )
2033
2034                if card_subtext is not None:
2035
2036                    base_text_width, base_text_height = self._base_text_render_size
2037                    text_key = (card_subtext, base_text_width, base_text_height)
2038                    trend = self.text_render_cache.get(text_key)
2039
2040                    if trend is None:
2041                        trend = graphics.render_page_from_chars(
2042                            self.font,
2043                            [card_subtext],
2044                            pygame.Rect(0, 0, base_text_width, base_text_height),
2045                            self.card_text_description_color,
2046                            centered=True,
2047                            vertical_centered=True
2048                        )
2049                        self.text_render_cache[text_key] = trend
2050
2051                    # The text rectangle also changes during the pressed-card
2052                    # animation. Scale the cached text layout instead of
2053                    # rendering the same string again at every animation step.
2054                    if base_text_width > 0 and base_text_height > 0:
2055                        text_scale_x = text_rect.width / base_text_width
2056                        text_scale_y = text_rect.height / base_text_height
2057                    else:
2058                        text_scale_x = 1.0
2059                        text_scale_y = 1.0
2060
2061                    for surf, pos in trend:
2062                        if text_scale_x != 1.0 or text_scale_y != 1.0:
2063                            scaled_text_size = (
2064                                max(1, int(round(surf.get_width() * text_scale_x))),
2065                                max(1, int(round(surf.get_height() * text_scale_y)))
2066                            )
2067                            rendered_text = pygame.transform.scale(surf, scaled_text_size)
2068                            rendered_text_pos = (
2069                                int(round(pos[0] * text_scale_x)),
2070                                int(round(pos[1] * text_scale_y))
2071                            )
2072                        else:
2073                            rendered_text = surf
2074                            rendered_text_pos = pos
2075
2076                        self.surface.blit(
2077                            rendered_text,
2078                            (
2079                                rendered_text_pos[0] + text_rect.x,
2080                                rendered_text_pos[1] + text_rect.y + self.main_list_yscroll
2081                            )
2082                        )
2083
2084    def render_full_image(self, cinfo: Renderable_CardInfo) -> None:
2085        """
2086        Renders the image of the given cardinfo as a full image.
2087        """
2088        cw, ch = self.width // 2, int(self.height * 0.9)
2089        center_frame = pygame.Rect(cw // 2, (self.height - ch) // 2, cw, ch)
2090        cimage = cinfo.get_card_image_rendered(center_frame)
2091        cpos = graphics.get_center_with_surface(cimage, center_frame)
2092
2093        self.full_image_surface.fill((*Colors.BLACK, 200))
2094        self.full_image_surface.blit(cimage, cpos)
2095
2096
2097    def get_card_subtext(
2098                            self,
2099                            y_position: int,
2100                            id_index: int,
2101                            main_list_index: int,
2102                            img_rect: pygame.Rect,
2103                            text_rect: pygame.Rect
2104                        ) -> str:
2105        """
2106        Returns the appropriate subtext for the
2107        current main list viewstate.
2108        Returning None means no subtext is rendered.
2109        """
2110        if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
2111            return None
2112        elif self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
2113            #returns the amount
2114            amount: int = self.main_list_cards[main_list_index][1]
2115            return f"x{amount}"

2121    def reload_current_group(self) -> None:
2122        """
2123        Does all rerendering needed after
2124        changing the current group,
2125        or anything in the current group.
2126        """
2127
2128        self.create_deckname_text()
2129        self.create_decksize_text()
2130        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2131
2132        self.raise_prerender_flag()

2134    def get_shown_group_decksize(self) -> int:
2135        """

2140    def add_group(
2141                    self,
2142                    groupname: str,
2143                    cardlist: cardlist_t = None,
2144                    is_mutable: bool = True,
2145                    is_copylist: bool = False,
2146                    is_renamable: bool = True,
2147
2148                    max_cards_selected: int = INFINITE,
2149                    max_size: int = INFINITE
2150
2151                    ) -> bool:
2152        """
2153        This creates a mew group with the given variables.
2154        Returns True on success, False on failure.
2155        """
2156
2157        if  not groupname or groupname in list(self.groups.keys()):
2158            return False
2159
2160        if len(self.groups) - 1 >= self.max_group_number:
2161            #create info
2162            self.print_info_text(
2163                                    text_page=RenderableCardListviewer.MAX_GROUP_NUMBER_REACHED_INFO_PAGE,
2164                                    text_color=RenderableCardListviewer.INFO_TEXT_ERROR_COLOR,
2165                                    fade_duration=RenderableCardListviewer.MAX_GROUP_NUMBER_REACHED_FADING_DURATION
2166                                )
2167
2168        if cardlist is None:
2169            cardlist = {}
2170
2171        group: group_t = Cardgroup.create_group(
2172                                                    cardlist=cardlist,
2173                                                    is_copylist=is_copylist,
2174                                                    is_mutable=is_mutable,
2175                                                    is_renamable=is_renamable,
2176                                                    max_cards_selected=max_cards_selected,
2177                                                    max_size=max_size
2178                                                )
2179
2180        self.groups[groupname] = group
2181
2182        return True

2219    def info_text_tick(self) -> None:
2220        """
2221        Handles the info text updates.
2222        """
2223
2224        percentage = self.info_text_fading_clock.elapsed() / self.current_info_text_fadeout_duration
2225
2226        if percentage >= 1.0:
2227            self.info_text_rendered = None
2228        else:
2229            fade = int((1.0 - percentage) * 255)
2230            self.info_text_surface.set_alpha(fade)

2291    def handle_dropdown_menu_selection(self, event: pygame.event.Event) -> None:
2292        """
2293        Handles actions taken when a event
2294        from the own dropdown menu is received.
2295        """
2296
2297        if event.type == ScrollableDropdownMenu.EventTypes.SELECT_ANIMATION_ENDED:
2298            #selection was done
2299            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2300                #getting the selected instance
2301                full_trace: list[tuple[str]] = event.selected_option_tuples
2302                selection: tuple[str] = full_trace[-1]
2303
2304                if selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.RANDOMIZED_SORTING:
2305                    self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.randomized
2306                    self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2307                    self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2308                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_DESCENDING_SORTING:
2309                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_descending:
2310                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_descending
2311                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2312                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2313                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_ASCENDING_SORTING:
2314                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_ascending:
2315                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_ascending
2316                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2317                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2318                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_DESCENDING_SORTING:
2319                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_descending:
2320                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_descending
2321                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2322                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2323                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_ASCENDING_SORTING:
2324                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_ascending:
2325                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_ascending
2326                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2327                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2328                #display types
2329                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_EACH_CARD_DISPLAY_TYPE:
2330                    if self.main_list_view_state != RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
2331                        self.main_list_view_state = RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD
2332                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2333
2334                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT_DISPLAY_TYPE:
2335                    if self.main_list_view_state != RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
2336                        self.main_list_view_state = RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT
2337                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2338
2339                #group selection
2340                elif full_trace[0] == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SELECT_GROUP_OPTION_KEY:
2341
2342                    self.shown_group = selection[0]
2343                    self.reload_current_group()
2344
2345                elif full_trace[0] == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.DELETE_GROUP_OPTION_KEY:
2346
2347                    dgroup = selection[0]
2348                    #initializes group deletion
2349                    if Cardgroup.is_deleteable(group=self.groups[dgroup]):
2350                        self.initialize_group_deletion(group_to_delete=dgroup)
2351                    else:
2352
2353                        self.print_info_text(
2354                                                text_page=RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_UNDELETEABLE_INFO_PAGE,
2355                                                text_color=RenderableCardListviewer.INFO_TEXT_ERROR_COLOR,
2356                                                fade_duration=RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_UNDELETEABLE_FADING_DURATION
2357                                                )
2358
2359                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.CREATE_GROUP_OPTION_KEY:
2360                    self.initialize_deck_creation_frame()
2361
2362

2402    #==================================
2403    # TICK FUNCTIONS AND ANIMATION HANDLING
2404    #==================================
2405
2406    def _get_render_signature(self) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
2407        """Return the state values that can change the rendered widget."""
2408        return (
2409            self.state,
2410            self.prev_state,
2411            self.selected_card_index,
2412            self.main_list_yscroll,
2413            self.shown_group,
2414            self.main_list_view_state,
2415            self.is_focused(),
2416            self.info_text_active(),
2417            self.focused_text_input_subframe is not None
2418        )
2419
2420    def _needs_continuous_prerender(self) -> bool:
2421        """Return True while a visual animation or timed effect is running."""
2422        animated_states = (
2423            RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP,
2424            RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN,
2425            RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP,
2426            RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_SELECTED_ANIMATION,
2427            RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_SELECTED_ANIMATION,
2428            RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION,
2429            RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_DELETION_POPUP_SHOWN
2430        )
2431
2432        return (
2433            self.state in animated_states
2434            or (
2435                self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED
2436                and self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2437            )
2438            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE
2439            or self.info_text_active()
2440            or self.focused_text_input_subframe is not None
2441        )
2442
2443    @override
2444    def tick(self) -> None:
2445        """
2446        Tick function.
2447        """
2448
2449        if self.intro_delay_clock.elapsed() >= self.intro_delay:
2450            self.manage_pygame_events()
2451
2452        if self.exit_flag_raised():
2453            return None
2454
2455        if self.is_focused():
2456
2457            """
2458            INFO TEXT
2459            """
2460
2461            if self.info_text_active():
2462                self.info_text_tick()
2463
2464            """
2465            DROPDOWN MENU
2466            """
2467
2468            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2469                self.dropdown_menu.tick()
2470
2471                #dropdown events
2472                dropdown_events = self.dropdown_menu.poll_events()
2473
2474                for event in dropdown_events:
2475                    self.handle_dropdown_menu_selection(event)
2476
2477            """
2478            STATE ACTIONS
2479            """
2480            #non input accepting states
2481            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP:
2482                self.move_one_row_up()
2483            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN:
2484                self.move_one_row_down()
2485            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP:
2486                self.move_all_rows_up()
2487            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN:
2488                if not self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.SHOW_IMAGE_KEY):
2489                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2490            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_SELECTED_ANIMATION:
2491                self.deckname_selected_animation()
2492            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_SELECTED_ANIMATION:
2493                self.menu_button_selected_animation()
2494            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.INITIALIZE_DECK_RENAMING_FRAME:
2495                self.initialize_deck_renaming_frame()
2496            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION:
2497                self.card_snapback_animation()
2498            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED:
2499                if not (self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RETURN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.ENTER_ALTERNATIVE)):
2500                    if self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
2501                        #if a card was focused, we need to animate putting it back in its original state
2502                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION
2503                        self.initialize_card_snapback_animation()
2504                    else:
2505                        self.state = self.prev_state
2506                        if self.enter_clock.elapsed() >= self.time_until_long_enter_pressed:
2507                            self.long_enter_pressed()
2508                        else:
2509                            self.enter_pressed()
2510                        self.key_clock.start()
2511                else:
2512                    if self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
2513                        self.card_pressed_animation()
2514
2515            else:
2516                #accept inputs
2517
2518                if self.key_clock.elapsed() > self.key_delay:
2519
2520                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE):
2521                        self.escape_pressed()
2522                        self.key_clock.start()
2523
2524                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LEFT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.LEFT_ALTERNATIVE):
2525                        self.left_pressed()
2526                        self.key_clock.start()
2527
2528                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RIGHT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.RIGHT_ALTERNATIVE):
2529                        self.right_pressed()
2530                        self.key_clock.start()
2531
2532                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_UP) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.UP_ALTERNATIVE):
2533                        self.up_pressed()
2534                        self.key_clock.start()
2535
2536                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_DOWN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.DOWN_ALTERNATIVE):
2537                        self.down_pressed()
2538                        self.key_clock.start()
2539
2540                    if self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.SHOW_IMAGE_KEY):
2541                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN
2542                        self.prerender_full_image()
2543                        self.key_clock.start()
2544
2545                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RETURN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.ENTER_ALTERNATIVE):
2546
2547                        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
2548                            self.cards_dict_before_enter = self.main_list_cards_dict[self.selected_card_index]
2549                            self.cards_rects_before_enter = self.main_list_cards_rects[self.cards_dict_before_enter[3]]#the cy
2550                            self.cards_rects_before_enter_index = [i for i in range(len(self.cards_rects_before_enter)) if self.cards_rects_before_enter[i][0] == self.selected_card_index][0]
2551                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED
2552                        self.enter_clock.start()
2553                        self.key_clock.start()
2554
2555                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_BACKSPACE) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY):
2556                        self.back_pressed()
2557                        self.key_clock.start()
2558        """
2559        SUBFRAMES ACTIVE
2560        """
2561        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECK_RENAMING_FRAME_ACTIVE:
2562            ret = self.focused_text_input_subframe.tick()
2563
2564            if ret is None:
2565
2566                #setting the groupname
2567                if self.focused_text_input_subframe.exit_with_enter():
2568
2569                    text = self.focused_text_input_subframe.get_input_text()
2570
2571                    if not text or text in list(self.groups.keys()):
2572
2573                        self.print_info_text(
2574                                                text_page=RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS_INFO_PAGE,
2575                                                text_color=RenderableCardListviewer.INFO_TEXT_ERROR_COLOR,
2576                                                fade_duration=RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS_ERROR_FADING_DURATION
2577                                            )
2578
2579                        self.focused_text_input_subframe.reset_exit_flag()
2580                        self.focused_text_input_subframe.reset_exit_type()
2581
2582                    else:
2583
2584                        data_cp = deepcopy(self.groups[self.shown_group])
2585                        del self.groups[self.shown_group]
2586                        self.shown_group = self.focused_text_input_subframe.get_input_text()
2587                        self.groups[self.shown_group] = data_cp
2588                        self.focused_text_input_subframe = None
2589                        self.focus()
2590                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
2591                        self.create_deckname_text()
2592                        self.create_dropdown_menu()
2593
2594                elif self.focused_text_input_subframe.exit_with_escape():
2595                    self.focused_text_input_subframe = None
2596                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
2597
2598                self.focus()
2599
2600                self.key_clock.start()
2601
2602        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECK_CREATION_FRAME_ACTIVE:
2603            ret = self.focused_text_input_subframe.tick()
2604
2605            if ret is None:
2606                self.finalize_deck_creation_frame()
2607
2608        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_DELETION_POPUP_SHOWN:
2609
2610            ret: Frame = self.group_deletion_popup.tick()
2611
2612            if ret is None:
2613                self.group_deletion_popup = None
2614                self.group_to_delete = None
2615                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2616
2617            else:
2618
2619                for event in self.group_deletion_popup.poll_events():
2620
2621                    if event.type == Popup.EventTypes.OPTION_SELECTED:
2622
2623                        #checking the option
2624                        if event.option_index == 0:
2625                            #YES
2626                            self.delete_group(self.group_to_delete)
2627
2628                        #normal state
2629                        self.focus()
2630                        self.group_deletion_popup = None
2631
2632                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2633
2634                        self.group_to_delete = None
2635
2636            self.key_clock.start()
2637
2638        # Only redraw when visible state changed, an explicit invalidation was
2639        # raised elsewhere, or a continuously animated element needs a new frame.
2640        render_signature = self._get_render_signature()
2641        if (
2642            render_signature != self._last_render_signature
2643            or self._needs_continuous_prerender()
2644        ):
2645            self.raise_prerender_flag()
2646        self._last_render_signature = render_signature
2647
2648        #prerendering
2649        if self.prerender_flag_raised():
2650            self.prerender()
2651            self.reset_prerender_flag()
2652
2653        return self
2654    """
2655    INTERACTION FUNCTIONS
2656    """
2657
2658    def left_pressed(self):
2659
2660        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
2661            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2662            self.selected_card_index = 0
2663        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
2664            #if we're at the leftmost state, leave the main list focus
2665            if (self.selected_card_index % self.cards_per_line) == 0:
2666                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
2667            else:
2668                self.selected_card_index -= 1
2669        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
2670            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED
2671        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
2672            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
2673        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
2674            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2675        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2676            self.dropdown_menu.move_left()

2678    def right_pressed(self):
2679
2680        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
2681            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2682            self.selected_card_index = 0
2683        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
2684            #if we're at the rightmost state, leave the main list focus
2685            if ((self.selected_card_index + 1) % self.cards_per_line) == 0:
2686                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
2687            else:
2688                self.selected_card_index += 1
2689
2690        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
2691            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
2692        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
2693            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED
2694        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
2695            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2696        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2697            self.dropdown_menu.move_right()
2698
2699    def up_pressed(self):
2700
2701        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
2702            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2703
2704        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED\
2705            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED\
2706            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
2707
2708            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
2709
2710        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
2711
2712            if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
2713                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2714                return
2715
2716            if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LSHIFT):
2717                if not self.fastscroll_enabled:
2718                    self.fastscroll_enabled = True
2719                    self.rowscroll_copy = self.rowscrolling_duration
2720                    self.rowscrolling_duration = self.fastscroll_duration
2721            elif self.fastscroll_enabled:
2722                self.fastscroll_enabled = False
2723                self.rowscrolling_duration = self.rowscroll_copy
2724            #check for going off, and if the index is in rendered rows
2725            if self.selected_card_index < self.cards_per_line:
2726                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2727            elif (self.selected_card_index - self.cards_per_line) not in [x[1] for x in self.rendered_rows]:
2728                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP
2729                self.initialize_move_one_row_up()
2730            else:
2731                self.selected_card_index -= self.cards_per_line
2732
2733        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2734            self.dropdown_menu.move_up()
2735
2736    def down_pressed(self):
2737
2738        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
2739            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2740
2741        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED\
2742            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED\
2743            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
2744
2745            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2746            self.selected_card_index = 0
2747            self.main_list_yscroll = 0
2748
2749        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
2750
2751            if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
2752                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
2753                return
2754            #check for going off, and if the index is in rendered rows
2755            if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LSHIFT):
2756                if not self.fastscroll_enabled:
2757                    self.fastscroll_enabled = True
2758                    self.rowscroll_copy = self.rowscrolling_duration
2759                    self.rowscrolling_duration = self.fastscroll_duration
2760            elif self.fastscroll_enabled:
2761                self.fastscroll_enabled = False
2762                self.rowscrolling_duration = self.rowscroll_copy
2763
2764            if self.selected_card_index >= (self.n_cards_shown - self.cards_per_line):
2765                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
2766                self.selected_card_index %= (self.n_cards_shown)
2767                self.selected_card_index -= (self.cards_per_line - self.n_cards_shown % self.cards_per_line)
2768                if self.selected_card_index < self.cards_per_line:
2769                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP
2770                    self.initialize_move_all_rows_up()
2771            elif len(self.rendered_rows) < (self.cards_per_line * self.cards_per_column):
2772                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
2773                self.selected_card_index %= self.n_cards_shown
2774            elif (self.selected_card_index + self.cards_per_line) not in [x[1] for x in self.rendered_rows]:
2775
2776                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN
2777                self.initialize_move_one_row_down()
2778            else:
2779                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
2780
2781        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2782            self.dropdown_menu.move_down()
2783
2784

3071    def card_pressed_animation(self):
3072
3073        percentage = self.enter_clock.elapsed() / self.time_until_long_enter_pressed
3074        percentage = min(percentage, 1.0)
3075
3076        self.enter_pressed_on_card_percentage = percentage
3077        #changing the frame dimensions
3078
3079        main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy = self.cards_dict_before_enter
3080        card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, _1, _2 = self.cards_rects_before_enter[self.cards_rects_before_enter_index]
3081
3082        size_margin = self.card_pressed_size_change_percentage * percentage
3083        img_rect = graphics.apply_margins(img_rect, size_margin, size_margin)
3084        txt_rect = graphics.apply_margins(txt_rect, size_margin, size_margin)
3085
3086        self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy)
3087        self.main_list_cards_rects[cy][self.cards_rects_before_enter_index] = (card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, txt_rect)

3172    def delete_group(self, group_to_delete: str) -> None:
3173        """
3174        Deletes the current group.
3175        """
3176
3177        del self.groups[group_to_delete]
3178
3179        if self.shown_group == group_to_delete:
3180            self.shown_group = list(self.groups.keys())[0] #any random group will do. At least the full cardlist will be available.
3181            self.rerender()
3182
3183        else:
3184            #only reconstruct the dropdownmenu
3185            self.create_dropdown_menu()
3186
3187        self.group_to_delete = None

3192
3193    def save_current_group_state(
3194                                    self,
3195                                    is_copylist: bool = None, #None means no change
3196                                    is_mutable: bool = None,  #None means no change
3197                                    is_renamable: bool = None, #None means no change
3198                                ) -> None:
3199        """
3200        Saves the current group state into self.groups.
3201        Be aware that self.groups is only a deepcopy of the given
3202        groups in __init__.
3203        """
3204
3205        group_dict: group_t = self.groups[self.shown_group]
3206        #creating the cardlist
3207        cardlist_dict: cardlist_t = {}
3208        #filling the cardlist
3209        for (cardclass, amount) in self.main_list_cards:
3210            cardlist_dict[cardclass] = amount
3211
3212        new_group: group_t = Cardgroup.copy_group(self.groups[self.shown_group])
3213        Cardgroup.cardlist(group=new_group, cardlist=cardlist_dict)
3214
3215        #saving to the current groups
3216        self.groups[self.shown_group] = new_group
3217
3218        #we do not need to change anything else, since all changes would have
3219        #been registered in the current variables.
3220
3221    def increase_selected_card_amount(self, amount: int) -> bool:
3222        """
3223        Increases the selected card amount by amount.
3224        Returns True if possible (if the amount stays equal or below
3225        the cardamount listed for the cardclass in the full cardlist)
3226        """
3227
3228        if amount < 0 or self.n_cards_shown == 0:
3229            return False
3230
3231        if self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD] and amount > 1:
3232            #only one decrease possible
3233            return False
3234
3235        group_ref: group_t = self.groups[self.shown_group]
3236
3237        #checking not to increase over the max size
3238        groupsize: int = Cardgroup.groupsize(group=group_ref)
3239        max_size: int = Cardgroup.max_size(group=group_ref)
3240
3241        if (groupsize + amount > max_size):
3242            return False
3243
3244        if  Cardgroup.is_copylist(group=group_ref)\
3245            or not Cardgroup.is_mutable(group=group_ref):
3246
3247            return False
3248
3249        #checking if the current list is mutable or a copylists
3250        main_list_cards_index,\
3251        img_rect,\
3252        text_rect,\
3253        cy                          = self.main_list_cards_dict[self.selected_card_index]
3254
3255        cardclass, current_amount = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_index]
3256
3257        max_amount = self.groups[RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_CARDLIST_NAME][cardclass]
3258
3259        if (current_amount + amount > max_amount):
3260            #not possible
3261            return False
3262        else:
3263
3264            self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_index] = (cardclass, current_amount + amount)
3265
3266        #we need prerendering
3267        if self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT]:
3268            self.raise_prerender_flag()
3269            self.create_decksize_text()
3270        elif self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD]:
3271            #recalculating the rects, but saving yscroll
3272            self.recalculate_main_list_positions(keep_current_state=True)
3273            self.raise_prerender_flag()
3274
3275        return True
3276
3277    def decrease_selected_card_amount(self, amount: int) -> bool:
3278        """
3279        Decreases the selected card amount by amount.
3280        Returns True if possible (if the amount stays above or equal to 0)
3281        else False.
3282        """
3283
3284        if amount < 0 or self.n_cards_shown == 0:
3285            return False
3286
3287        if self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD] and amount > 1:
3288            #only one decrease possible
3289            return False
3290
3291        group_ref: group_t = self.groups[self.shown_group]
3292
3293        if  (Cardgroup.is_copylist(group=group_ref) and amount > 1)\
3294            or not Cardgroup.is_mutable(group=group_ref):
3295
3296            return False
3297
3298        main_list_cards_index,\
3299        img_rect,\
3300        text_rect,\
3301        cy                          = self.main_list_cards_dict[self.selected_card_index]
3302
3303        cardclass, current_amount = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_index]
3304
3305        if (current_amount - amount < 0):
3306            #not possible
3307            return False
3308        else:
3309            if (current_amount - amount) == 0:
3310                #remove the entry
3311                self.main_list_cards.pop(main_list_cards_index)
3312                if self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT]:
3313                    self.selected_card_index -= 1
3314            else:
3315                self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_index] = (cardclass, current_amount - amount)
3316
3317        #the selected index needs to mov
3318
3319        #we need prerendering
3320        if self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT]:
3321            self.raise_prerender_flag()
3322            self.create_decksize_text()
3323        elif self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD]:
3324            self.selected_card_index -= 1
3325            #recalculating the rects, but saving yscroll
3326            self.recalculate_main_list_positions(keep_current_state=True)
3327
3328        return True
3329
3330    def get_selected_card_with_amount(self) -> tuple[ Type[Renderable_CardInfo], int ]:
3331        """
3332        Returns the currently selected cardclass with amount.
3333        """
3334
3335        if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
3336            return None
3337
3338        main_list_cards_index,\
3339        img_rect,\
3340        text_rect,\
3341        cy                          = self.main_list_cards_dict[self.selected_card_index]
3342
3343        if self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT]:
3344            return self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_index]
3345        elif self.main_list_view_state in [RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD]:
3346            cclass: Type[Renderable_CardInfo] = None
3347            amount: int = -1
3348
3349            cclass, amount = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_index]
3350
3351            return (cclass, 1)

 228    #==================================
 229    # SORTING FUNCTIONS
 230    #==================================
 231
 232    class SortingFunctions:
 233        """
 234        Functions to sort cardlists.
 235        Each cardlist is: [(RenderableCard (Class), amount)]
 236        """
 237
 238        @staticmethod
 239        def no_order(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 240            """
 241            Returns the cardlist in the same order as
 242            it was before.
 243            """
 244            return cardlist
 245
 246        @staticmethod
 247        def randomized(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 248            """
 249            Returns the cardlist after a random shuffle.
 250            """
 251            cardlist_copy = cardlist.copy()
 252            random.shuffle(cardlist_copy)
 253            return cardlist_copy
 254
 255        @staticmethod
 256        def name_descending(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 257            """
 258            Sorts by name descending.
 259            """
 260            clist = cardlist.copy()
 261            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].info().name)
 262            return clist
 263
 264        @staticmethod
 265        def name_ascending(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 266            """
 267            Sorts by name ascending.
 268            """
 269            clist = cardlist.copy()
 270            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].info().name)
 271            clist.reverse()
 272            return clist
 273
 274        @staticmethod
 275        def amount_descending(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 276            """
 277            Sorts by amount descending.
 278            """
 279            clist = cardlist.copy()
 280            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
 281            return clist
 282
 283        @staticmethod
 284        def amount_ascending(cardlist: listviewer_cardlist_t) -> listviewer_cardlist_t:
 285            """
 286            Sorts by amount ascending.
 287            """
 288            clist = cardlist.copy()
 289            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
 290            clist.reverse()
 291            return clist
