 298    class FocusedTextInputFrame(Frame):
 299        """
 300        Provides a text input frame.
 301        """
 302
 303        TEXT_ENTERED: id_t = R_ID()
 304        ESCAPE: id_t = R_ID()
 305
 306        def __init__(
 307                    self,
 308                    frame_dim: pygame.Rect,
 309                    parent_frame: Frame,
 310                    focus_group: str = "",
 311                    has_focus: bool = True
 312                    ):
 313
 314            #initializing
 315            Frame.__init__(
 316                            self,
 317                            frame_enum=FrameEnums.UNDEFINED,
 318                            data=None,
 319                            frame_dim=frame_dim,
 320                            parent_frame=parent_frame,
 321                            focus_group=focus_group,
 322                            has_focus=has_focus
 323                            )
 324
 325            self.text_input: TextInput = None
 326            """
 327            Text input reference.
 328            """
 329            self.text_input_frame: pygame.Rect = None
 330            """
 331            Frame_dim for self.text_input.
 332            """
 333            self.background_color: color_t = Colors.BLACK
 334            """
 335            Background color.
 336            """
 337            self.background_alpha: int = 127
 338            """
 339            Alpha value for the background.
 340            """
 341            self.escape_released: bool = False
 342            """
 343            For checking if escaping the frame is possible.
 344            """
 345            self._exit_type: id_t = None
 346            """
 347            The state describing how the frame was exited.
 348            """
 349            self.intro_delay: float = 100#ms
 350            """
 351            The intro delay.
 352            """
 353            self.intro_delay_clock: Clock = Clock()
 354            """
 355            Intro delay clock.
 356            """
 357
 358            self.rerender()
 359
 360        @override
 361        def rerender(self) -> None:
 362            """
 363            Rerendering.
 364            """
 365            self.text_input_frame = pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width//2, self.height//10)
 366            xc, yc = graphics.get_center_with_rect(self.frame_dim, self.text_input_frame)
 367            #setting the centered position
 368            self.text_input_frame.x = xc
 369            self.text_input_frame.y = yc
 370            #creating the text input
 371            self.text_input = TextInput(
 372                                        self.text_input_frame,
 373                                        focus_group=self.focus_group,
 374                                        has_focus=True #starts out with focus
 375                                        )
 376
 377            self.raise_prerender_flag()
 378            self.intro_delay_clock.start()
 379
 380        @override
 381        def prerender(self) -> None:
 382            """
 383            Prerendering.
 384            """
 385            self.surface.fill((*self.background_color, self.background_alpha))
 386            self.text_input.render(self.surface)
 387
 388        def set_input_text(self, text: str = "") -> None:
 389            """
 390            Sets the text for self.input_text_frame.
 391            """
 392            self.text_input.set_text(text)
 393
 394        def get_input_text(self) -> str:
 395            """
 396            Returns the text of self.text_input.
 397            """
 398            return self.text_input.get_text()
 399
 400        def reset_exit_type(self) -> None:
 401            """
 402            Resets the exit type.
 403            """
 404            self._exit_type = None
 405
 406        def exit_with_enter(self) -> bool:
 407            """
 408            Is true if this frame exited with an enter pressed.
 409            """
 410            return (self._exit_type == RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.TEXT_ENTERED)
 411
 412        def exit_with_escape(self) -> bool:
 413            """
 414            Is true if this frame was aborted.
 415            """
 416            return (self._exit_type == RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.ESCAPE)
 417
 418        @override
 419        def tick(self) -> None:
 420            """
 421            Tick function.
 422            """
 423
 424            if self.intro_delay_clock.elapsed() > self.intro_delay:
 425                self.manage_pygame_events()
 426
 427            ret: Frame = self.text_input.tick()
 428            #polling textinput events
 429            for event in self.text_input.poll_events():
 430
 431                #propagating events
 432                self.push_event(event)
 433
 434                if event.type == TextInput.EventTypes.TEXT_ENTERED:
 435                    self._exit_type = RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.TEXT_ENTERED
 436                    self.raise_exit_flag()
 437
 438            if self.exit_flag_raised():
 439                return None
 440
 441            if self.is_focused():
 442                #checking for any movement key
 443                if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LEFT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.LEFT_ALTERNATIVE)\
 444                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RIGHT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.RIGHT_ALTERNATIVE)\
 445                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_UP) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.UP_ALTERNATIVE)\
 446                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_DOWN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.DOWN_ALTERNATIVE):
 447
 448                    self.text_input.focus()
 449
 450                if (self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY) or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE)) and self.escape_released:
 451                    self._exit_type = RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.ESCAPE
 452                    self.raise_exit_flag()
 453
 454                if not (self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY) and self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE)) and not self.escape_released:
 455                    self.escape_released = True
 456
 457            if not self.text_input.is_focused() and not self.is_focused():
 458                self.focus()
 459                self.escape_released = False
 460
 461            if self.text_input.is_focused():
 462                self.raise_prerender_flag()
 463
 464            if self.prerender_flag_raised():
 465                self.prerender()
 466                self.reset_prerender_flag()
 467
 468            return self

1403    #==================================
1404    # VALIDITY CHECKS
1405    #==================================
1406
1407    def _check_validity(self) -> None:
1408        """
1409        Checks the validity of the own variables.
1410        """
1411        if len(self.groups) == 0:
1412            raise RuntimeError("You need at least one group")
1413        if len(self.groups) - 1 > self.max_group_number: #-1 for full_cardlist
1414            raise RuntimeError("Too many groups. Adjust your max_group_size")
1415        if self.cards_per_line <= 0 or self.cards_per_column <= 0:
1416            raise RuntimeError("cards_per_line and cards_per_column have to be greater than 0")
1417
1418        #checking the group and full cardlists consistency.
1419        #if the group has a cardclass where the amount is greater than the full cardlist
1420        #and is no copylist, its invalid.
1421
1422        for (groupname, group) in self.groups.items():
1423
1424            #checking if it is copylist
1425            is_copylist: bool = Cardgroup.is_copylist(group=group)
1426            if is_copylist:
1427                #skip copylists
1428                continue
1429
1430            #otherwise, check amounts
1431            cardlist: cardlist_t = Cardgroup.cardlist(group=group)
1432            for (cardclass, amount) in cardlist.items():
1433
1434                if amount > self.full_cardlist[cardclass]: #a group has more of this card than allowed: error
1435                    raise RuntimeError(
1436                                        f"ERROR:    Group {groupname} has more copies of {str(cardclass)} than the full cardlist.\n"\
1437                                        f"          {groupname}: {str(amount)} > full_cardlist: {str(self.full_cardlist[cardclass])}"
1438                                        )
1439
1440        #no error, groups were valid
1441
1442    #==================================
1443    # RENDERING
1444    #==================================
1445
1446    @override
1447    def rerender(self) -> None:
1448        """
1449        Rerendering
1450        """
1451
1452        """
1453        VALIDITY CHECK
1454        """
1455        self._check_validity()
1456
1457        """
1458        INFO TEXT
1459        """
1460
1461        iheight: int = int(self.height * self.info_text_vlen_p)
1462
1463        self.info_text_frame = pygame.Rect( 0,
1464                                            self.height - iheight,
1465                                            int(self.width * self.info_text_hlen_p),
1466                                            iheight
1467                                            )
1468
1469        self.info_text_surface = pygame.Surface((self.info_text_frame.width, self.info_text_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1470        self.info_text_rendered = None
1471
1472        """
1473        FULL FRAME + BORDER FRAME
1474        """
1475
1476        #resetting card index
1477        self.selected_card_index = 0
1478        #creating the full image surface
1479        self.full_image_surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1480        #getting border width and height
1481        self.border_width = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.width)
1482        self.border_height = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.height)
1483        #the inner area is the frame inside without the border
1484        self.inner_area = pygame.Rect(
1485                                        self.x + self.border_width,
1486                                        self.y + self.border_height,
1487                                        self.width - 2*self.border_width,
1488                                        self.height - 2*self.border_height
1489
1490                                        )
1491        relative_inner_frame_dim = graphics.position_relative(anchor_rect=self.frame_dim, make_relative_rect=self.inner_area)
1492        #popup frame
1493        self.popup_frame_dim = graphics.apply_margins(relative_inner_frame_dim, self.popup_hmargin, self.popup_vmargin)
1494        #calculating actual border outline sizes
1495        self.border_outline_width = int(self.border_width * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
1496        self.border_outline_height = int(self.border_height * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
1497        #selecting
1498        self.used_border_outline_size = min(self.border_outline_width, self.border_outline_height)
1499        #the inner border corners
1500        self.inner_border_corners = [
1501                                    (self.border_width-self.used_border_outline_size, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
1502                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
1503                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.height - self.border_height + self.used_border_outline_size),
1504                                    (self.border_width - self.used_border_outline_size, self.height - self.border_height)
1505                                    ]
1506        #(rect, color)
1507        self.border_lines = [
1508                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
1509                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_width, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
1510                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
1511                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_height, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
1512
1513                                #outer outline
1514                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
1515                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_outline_width, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
1516                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
1517                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_outline_height, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color)
1518
1519                                #inner outline will be calculated
1520                            ]
1521
1522        #helper function, connects the inner border corners
1523        def rs(p1: point_t, p2: point_t) -> pygame.Rect:
1524            """
1525            This inner function calculates
1526            the rectangles for the inner outline.
1527            """
1528
1529            x: int = p1[0]
1530            y: int = p1[1]
1531            #x and y of the first point
1532
1533            w: int = p2[0] - p1[0]
1534            if w == 0:
1535                w = self.used_border_outline_size
1536
1537            h: int = p2[1] - p1[1]
1538            if h == 0:
1539                h = self.used_border_outline_size
1540
1541            if w < 0 or h < 0:
1542
1543                x = p2[0]
1544                y = p2[1]
1545
1546                w = p1[0] - p2[0]
1547                if w == 0:
1548                    w = self.used_border_outline_size
1549
1550                h = p1[1] - p2[1]
1551                if h == 0:
1552                    h = self.used_border_outline_size
1553
1554            #x, y are the top left, w and h the width
1555            #if any of the width or height are the same,
1556            #they are on top of each other and need to be
1557            #expanded by the used border outline size
1558
1559            return pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)
1560
1561        #creating the render rectangles
1562        for i in range(len(self.inner_border_corners)+1):
1563            #wrap around by one to connect the last point with the first
1564
1565            i1: int = i % len(self.inner_border_corners)
1566            i2: int = (i+1) % len(self.inner_border_corners)
1567            #indices
1568            p1: point_t = None #the first point
1569            p2: point_t = None #the second point
1570            p1, p2 = self.inner_border_corners[i1], self.inner_border_corners[i2]
1571            #constructing and adding a rect to the border lines.
1572            self.border_lines.append((rs(p1, p2), self.border_frame_outline_color))
1573
1574        """
1575        MENU LABEL AND INNER MENU LABEL
1576        """
1577        self.menu_label_height = int(self.inner_area.height * self.menu_label_vmargin)
1578        self.menu_label_surface = pygame.Surface((self.inner_area.width, self.menu_label_height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1579        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = self.menu_label_surface.copy()
1580        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
1581        self.menu_label_surface_pos = (self.inner_area.x, self.inner_area.y)
1582        #calculating menu label dimensions
1583        self.menu_label_frame = self.inner_area.copy()
1584        self.menu_label_frame.height = self.menu_label_height
1585        #inner menu label is the label after applying the margins
1586        self.inner_menu_label_frame = self.menu_label_frame.copy()
1587        self.inner_menu_label_frame = graphics.apply_margins(self.inner_menu_label_frame, self.menu_label_inner_hmargin, self.menu_label_inner_vmargin)
1588
1589
1590        """
1591        -----------------------------------------
1592        MENU LABEL WIDGETS
1593        -----------------------------------------
1594        """
1595
1596        #now calculating the menu options
1597        self.menu_button_frame,\
1598        self.deckname_frame,\
1599        self.decksize_frame = graphics.split_rect_horizontally(
1600                                                                    pygame.Rect(
1601                                                                                    self.inner_menu_label_frame.x - self.menu_label_frame.x,
1602                                                                                    self.inner_menu_label_frame.y - self.menu_label_frame.y,
1603                                                                                    self.inner_menu_label_frame.width,
1604                                                                                    self.inner_menu_label_frame.height
1605                                                                    ),
1606
1607                                                                    [
1608                                                                        self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin,
1609                                                                        1.0-(self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin + self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin),
1610                                                                        self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin
1611                                                                    ]
1612                                                                )
1613        #now rendering the menu items
1614        #rendering the menu button
1615        self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered,\
1616        self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position_smoothscale(self.menu_button_unfocused_image, self.menu_button_frame)
1617        self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered,\
1618        self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position_smoothscale(self.menu_button_focused_image, self.menu_button_frame)
1619
1620
1621
1622        """
1623        -----------------------------------------
1624        CARD POSITION CALCULATIONS
1625        -----------------------------------------
1626        """
1627
1628        #getting the inner area for the cardlist
1629        self.main_list_frame = self.inner_area.copy()
1630
1631        self.main_list_frame.y += self.menu_label_frame.height
1632        self.main_list_frame.height -= self.menu_label_frame.height
1633
1634        #getting the inner main list
1635        self.inner_main_list_frame = graphics.apply_margins(self.main_list_frame, self.main_list_hmargin, self.main_list_vmargin)
1636
1637        self.create_dropdown_menu()
1638        #now getting the card positions
1639        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1640
1641        self.key_clock.start()
1642        self.intro_delay_clock.start()
1643        #prerendering
1644        self.raise_prerender_flag()
1645
1646    @override
1647    def prerender(self) -> None:
1648        """
1649        Prerendering.
1650        """
1651
1652        self.surface.fill(self.main_list_color)
1653        self.menu_label_surface.fill(self.menu_label_color)
1654        #rendering visible cards
1655        self.render_list_with_yscroll()
1656
1657        for rect, color in self.border_lines:
1658            pygame.draw.rect(self.surface, color, rect)
1659
1660        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
1661            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = pygame.Surface((self.menu_button_frame.width, self.menu_button_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1662            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
1663            self.menu_label_surface.blit(self.menu_label_highlighted_surface, (self.menu_button_frame.x, self.menu_button_frame.y))
1664        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
1665            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = pygame.Surface((self.deckname_frame.width, self.deckname_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1666            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
1667            self.menu_label_surface.blit(self.menu_label_highlighted_surface, (self.deckname_frame.x, self.deckname_frame.y))
1668        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1669            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = pygame.Surface((self.decksize_frame.width, self.decksize_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1670            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
1671            self.menu_label_surface.blit(self.menu_label_highlighted_surface, (self.decksize_frame.x, self.decksize_frame.y))
1672        #widgets
1673        #button
1674        button_img = (self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered if self.state in\
1675
1676                        [RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED,
1677                        RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_SELECTED_ANIMATION]\
1678
1679                        else self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered)
1680
1681        button_pos = (self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered_pos if self.state in\
1682
1683                        [RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED,
1684                        RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_SELECTED_ANIMATION]\
1685
1686                        else self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered_pos)
1687
1688        self.menu_label_surface.blit(button_img, button_pos)
1689        #deckname
1690        for surf, pos in self.deckname_rendered_and_positions:
1691            self.menu_label_surface.blit(surf, pos)
1692        for surf, pos in self.decksize_rendered_and_positions:
1693            self.menu_label_surface.blit(surf, pos)
1694
1695        #bliting the widgets onto the label
1696        self.surface.blit(self.menu_label_surface, self.menu_label_surface_pos)
1697
1698        if self.info_text_active():
1699            self.info_text_surface.fill((*Colors.BLACK, self.info_text_surface_alpha))
1700            for surf, pos in self.info_text_rendered:
1701                self.info_text_surface.blit(surf, pos)
1702            self.surface.blit(self.info_text_surface, (self.info_text_frame.x, self.info_text_frame.y))
1703
1704        if  self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE or\
1705            (self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED and self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE):
1706
1707            self.dropdown_menu.render(self.surface)
1708
1709        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN:
1710            self.surface.blit(self.full_image_surface, (0, 0))
1711        elif self.focused_text_input_subframe is not None:
1712            self.focused_text_input_subframe.render(self.surface)
1713
1714        #checking for group deletion popup
1715        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_DELETION_POPUP_SHOWN:
1716            self.group_deletion_popup.render(self.surface)
1717
1718    def create_deckname_text(self) -> None:
1719        """
1720        Creates self.deckname_rendered_and_positions.
1721        """
1722

1748    def recalculate_main_list_positions(self, keep_current_state: bool = False) -> None:
1749
1750        """
1751        The method to recalculate
1752        the rectangles and positions of the card previews.
1753
1754        if keep_current_state == True,
1755        the cards wont be reloaded, the yscroll will stay the same,
1756        and the selected index will only change if it is invalid.
1757        """
1758        # Keep cached resources when only the group/order changes. They depend
1759        # on the render dimensions, not on the card's screen position.
1760        previous_image_size = (self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
1761        previous_text_size = self._base_text_render_size
1762
1763        #getting the separator width
1764        self.main_list_hseparator_width = int(self.inner_main_list_frame.width * self.main_list_separator_h_percentage)
1765        self.main_list_vseparator_height = int(self.inner_main_list_frame.height * self.main_list_separator_v_percentage)
1766        #getting the remaining width
1767        self.main_list_hseparator_size =  (self.main_list_hseparator_width // (self.cards_per_line-1) if self.cards_per_line > 1 else 0)
1768        self.main_list_vseparator_size = (self.main_list_vseparator_height // (self.cards_per_column-1) if self.cards_per_column > 1 else 0)
1769        #calculating the shown cardsizes
1770        self.main_list_cwidth = (self.inner_main_list_frame.width - self.main_list_hseparator_width) // self.cards_per_line
1771        self.main_list_cheight = (self.inner_main_list_frame.height - self.main_list_vseparator_height) // self.cards_per_column
1772
1773        if not keep_current_state:
1774            gcards = Cardgroup.cardlist(group=self.groups[self.shown_group])
1775            gcards = [(key, value) for key, value in gcards.items()]
1776            self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(gcards)
1777
1778            self.selected_card_index = 0
1779            self.main_list_yscroll = 0
1780
1781        #rendering all cards, and adding their position
1782        self.subtext_width = 0
1783        self.subtext_height = 0
1784        self.cardimage_width = 0
1785        self.cardimage_height = 0
1786        self.main_list_card_height = 0
1787
1788        if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
1789            self.subtext_width = self.main_list_cwidth
1790            self.subtext_height = int(self.main_list_cheight * self.subtext_margin)
1791            self.cardimage_width = self.main_list_cwidth
1792            self.cardimage_height = self.main_list_cheight - self.subtext_height
1793        else:
1794            self.subtext_width = 0
1795            self.subtext_height = 0
1796            self.cardimage_width = self.main_list_cwidth
1797            self.cardimage_height = self.main_list_cheight
1798
1799        # Text surfaces are rendered into the standard text rectangle. During
1800        # the pressed-card animation, the cached result is scaled to the
1801        # animated rectangle instead of being rerendered at every size.
1802        base_text_rect = graphics.apply_margins(
1803            pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height),
1804            self.cardtext_hmargin,
1805            self.cardtext_vmargin
1806        )
1807        self._base_text_render_size = base_text_rect.size
1808
1809        current_image_size = (self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
1810        if previous_image_size != current_image_size:
1811            self.card_render_cache.clear()
1812            self.shadow_render_cache.clear()
1813
1814        if previous_text_size != self._base_text_render_size:
1815            self.text_render_cache.clear()
1816
1817        cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
1818        cy = self.inner_main_list_frame.y + (self.inner_main_list_frame.height // 2 - self.main_list_cheight // 2 if self.cards_per_column == 1 else 0)
1819
1820        main_list_cards_index = 0
1821        count = 0
1822        card_id_index = 0
1823
1824        self.main_list_cards_dict = {}
1825        self.main_list_cards_rects = {}
1826
1827        """
1828        Creating and assigning card previews.
1829        """
1830
1831        for cardclass, amount in self.main_list_cards:
1832
1833            if amount == 0:
1834                main_list_cards_index += 1
1835                continue
1836
1837            if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
1838
1839                img_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy, self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
1840                text_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy + self.cardimage_height, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height)
1841                #applying the margins
1842                text_rect = graphics.apply_margins(text_rect, self.cardtext_hmargin, self.cardtext_vmargin)
1843
1844                if cy not in self.main_list_cards_rects:
1845                    self.main_list_cards_rects[cy] = []
1846
1847                self.main_list_cards_rects[cy].append((card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect))
1848                self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect, cy)
1849
1850                main_list_cards_index += 1
1851                card_id_index += 1
1852
1853                cx += self.main_list_cwidth + self.main_list_hseparator_size
1854
1855                if not (card_id_index) % self.cards_per_line:
1856
1857                    cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
1858                    cy += self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_vseparator_size
1859
1860            elif self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
1861
1862                for cardcp in range(amount):
1863
1864                    img_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy, self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
1865                    text_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy + self.cardimage_height, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height)
1866
1867                    if cy not in self.main_list_cards_rects:
1868                        self.main_list_cards_rects[cy] = []
1869
1870                    self.main_list_cards_rects[cy].append((card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect))
1871                    self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect, cy)
1872
1873                    card_id_index += 1
1874
1875                    cx += self.main_list_cwidth + self.main_list_hseparator_size
1876
1877                    if not (card_id_index) % self.cards_per_line:
1878
1879                        cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
1880                        cy += self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_vseparator_size
1881
1882                main_list_cards_index += 1
1883
1884        self.n_cards_shown = card_id_index
1885        # Dict insertion order follows the ascending row positions generated
1886        # above, so this tuple is sorted and can be searched with bisect.
1887        self.main_list_row_positions = tuple(self.main_list_cards_rects)
1888
1889        #rendering the name
1890        self.create_deckname_text()
1891        #rendering the decksize
1892        self.create_decksize_text()
1893
1894        #checking the selected index
1895        if self.selected_card_index < 0 or self.selected_card_index >= self.n_cards_shown:
1896            self.selected_card_index = 0
1897
1898
1899    def render_list_with_yscroll(self) -> None:
1900        """
1901        Renders only visible card rows and reuses cached image, text, and
1902        shadow surfaces wherever possible.
1903        """
1904        self.rendered_rows = []
1905
1906        row_positions = self.main_list_row_positions
1907        if not row_positions:
1908            return
1909
1910        # Find the first and last rows intersecting the visible list area.
1911        # This avoids scanning every row when the card list is very large.
1912        visible_top = (
1913            self.inner_main_list_frame.y
1914            - self.main_list_yscroll
1915            - self.main_list_cheight
1916        )
1917        visible_bottom = (
1918            self.inner_main_list_frame.bottom
1919            - self.main_list_yscroll
1920        )
1921        first_row = bisect_left(row_positions, visible_top)
1922        after_last_row = bisect_right(row_positions, visible_bottom)
1923
1924        base_image_width = self.cardimage_width
1925        base_image_height = self.cardimage_height
1926
1927        for cy in row_positions[first_row:after_last_row]:
1928            for id_index, main_list_cards_idx, img_rect, text_rect in self.main_list_cards_rects[cy]:
1929                self.rendered_rows.append((cy, id_index, main_list_cards_idx, img_rect, text_rect))
1930                cinfo = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_idx][0].info()
1931
1932                # Cache the image at its normal layout size. Card-press
1933                # animation changes the rectangle every tick, so cache the
1934                # stable base surface and scale that surface for the animation.
1935                image_key = (
1936                    cinfo.card_image_path,
1937                    base_image_width,
1938                    base_image_height
1939                )
1940                cached_image = self.card_render_cache.get(image_key)
1941                if cached_image is None:
1942                    cached_image = graphics.img_load_and_position_smoothscale(
1943                        cinfo.card_image_path,
1944                        pygame.Rect(0, 0, base_image_width, base_image_height)
1945                    )
1946                    self.card_render_cache[image_key] = cached_image
1947                    if len(self.card_render_cache) > self.CARD_IMAGE_CACHE_LIMIT:
1948                        self.card_render_cache.popitem(last=False)
1949                else:
1950                    self.card_render_cache.move_to_end(image_key)
1951
1952                img, base_img_pos = cached_image
1953                img_pos = base_img_pos
1954
1955                if (
1956                    img_rect.width != base_image_width
1957                    or img_rect.height != base_image_height
1958                ) and base_image_width > 0 and base_image_height > 0:
1959                    scale_x = img_rect.width / base_image_width
1960                    scale_y = img_rect.height / base_image_height
1961                    scaled_size = (
1962                        max(1, int(round(img.get_width() * scale_x))),
1963                        max(1, int(round(img.get_height() * scale_y)))
1964                    )
1965                    img = pygame.transform.smoothscale(img, scaled_size)
1966                    img_pos = (
1967                        int(round(base_img_pos[0] * scale_x)),
1968                        int(round(base_img_pos[1] * scale_y))
1969                    )
1970
1971                img_render_pos = (
1972                    img_rect.x + img_pos[0],
1973                    img_rect.y + img_pos[1] + self.main_list_yscroll
1974                )
1975
1976                if (
1977                    self.selected_card_index == id_index
1978                    and self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1979                ):
1980                    # Scale the selected card slightly. Use integer dimensions
1981                    # because pygame.transform.scale expects integer sizes.
1982                    img_x_inc = max(1, int(round(img.get_width() * 0.1)))
1983                    img_y_inc = max(1, int(round(img.get_height() * 0.1)))
1984                    img = pygame.transform.scale(
1985                        img,
1986                        (img.get_width() + img_x_inc, img.get_height() + img_y_inc)
1987                    )
1988                    img_render_pos = (
1989                        img_render_pos[0] - img_x_inc // 2,
1990                        img_render_pos[1] - img_y_inc // 2
1991                    )
1992
1993                shadow_rect = pygame.Rect(
1994                    img_render_pos[0],
1995                    img_render_pos[1],
1996                    img.get_width(),
1997                    img.get_height()
1998                )
1999                shadow_rect.x += int(self.cardshadow_hoffset_p * shadow_rect.width)
2000                shadow_rect.y += int(self.cardshadow_voffset_p * shadow_rect.height)
2001
2002                shadow_color = (
2003                    (*Colors.BLACK, self.cardshadow_alpha)
2004                    if (
2005                        id_index != self.selected_card_index
2006                        or self.state != RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2007                    )
2008                    else (*Colors.YELLOW, self.selected_cardshadow_alpha)
2009                )
2010
2011                # Shadow surfaces are identical for cards with equal size and
2012                # color; reuse them instead of allocating one every frame.
2013                shadow_key = (shadow_rect.size, shadow_color)
2014                shadow_surf = self.shadow_render_cache.get(shadow_key)
2015                if shadow_surf is None:
2016                    shadow_surf = pygame.Surface(shadow_rect.size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
2017                    shadow_surf.fill(shadow_color)
2018                    self.shadow_render_cache[shadow_key] = shadow_surf
2019                    if len(self.shadow_render_cache) > self.SHADOW_CACHE_LIMIT:
2020                        self.shadow_render_cache.popitem(last=False)
2021                else:
2022                    self.shadow_render_cache.move_to_end(shadow_key)
2023
2024                self.surface.blit(shadow_surf, (shadow_rect.x, shadow_rect.y))
2025                self.surface.blit(img, img_render_pos)
2026
2027                card_subtext: str = self.get_card_subtext(
2028                                                            y_position=cy,
2029                                                            id_index=id_index,
2030                                                            main_list_index=main_list_cards_idx,
2031                                                            img_rect=img_rect,
2032                                                            text_rect=text_rect
2033                                                            )
2034
2035                if card_subtext is not None:
2036
2037                    base_text_width, base_text_height = self._base_text_render_size
2038                    text_key = (card_subtext, base_text_width, base_text_height)
2039                    trend = self.text_render_cache.get(text_key)
2040
2041                    if trend is None:
2042                        trend = graphics.render_page_from_chars(
2043                            self.font,
2044                            [card_subtext],
2045                            pygame.Rect(0, 0, base_text_width, base_text_height),
2046                            self.card_text_description_color,
2047                            centered=True,
2048                            vertical_centered=True
2049                        )
2050                        self.text_render_cache[text_key] = trend
2051
2052                    # The text rectangle also changes during the pressed-card
2053                    # animation. Scale the cached text layout instead of
2054                    # rendering the same string again at every animation step.
2055                    if base_text_width > 0 and base_text_height > 0:
2056                        text_scale_x = text_rect.width / base_text_width
2057                        text_scale_y = text_rect.height / base_text_height
2058                    else:
2059                        text_scale_x = 1.0
2060                        text_scale_y = 1.0
2061
2062                    for surf, pos in trend:
2063                        if text_scale_x != 1.0 or text_scale_y != 1.0:
2064                            scaled_text_size = (
2065                                max(1, int(round(surf.get_width() * text_scale_x))),
2066                                max(1, int(round(surf.get_height() * text_scale_y)))
2067                            )
2068                            rendered_text = pygame.transform.scale(surf, scaled_text_size)
2069                            rendered_text_pos = (
2070                                int(round(pos[0] * text_scale_x)),
2071                                int(round(pos[1] * text_scale_y))
2072                            )
2073                        else:
2074                            rendered_text = surf
2075                            rendered_text_pos = pos
2076
2077                        self.surface.blit(
2078                            rendered_text,
2079                            (
2080                                rendered_text_pos[0] + text_rect.x,
2081                                rendered_text_pos[1] + text_rect.y + self.main_list_yscroll
2082                            )
2083                        )
2084
2085    def render_full_image(self, cinfo: Renderable_CardInfo) -> None:
2086        """
2087        Renders the image of the given cardinfo as a full image.
2088        """
2089        cw, ch = self.width // 2, int(self.height * 0.9)
2090        center_frame = pygame.Rect(cw // 2, (self.height - ch) // 2, cw, ch)
2091        cimage = cinfo.get_card_image_rendered(center_frame)
2092        cpos = graphics.get_center_with_surface(cimage, center_frame)
2093
2094        self.full_image_surface.fill((*Colors.BLACK, 200))
2095        self.full_image_surface.blit(cimage, cpos)
2096

2098    def get_card_subtext(
2099                            self,
2100                            y_position: int,
2101                            id_index: int,
2102                            main_list_index: int,
2103                            img_rect: pygame.Rect,

2105                        ) -> str:

2116            return f"x{amount}"

2141    def add_group(
2142                    self,
2143                    groupname: str,
2144                    cardlist: cardlist_t = None,
2145                    is_mutable: bool = True,
2146                    is_copylist: bool = False,
2147                    is_renamable: bool = True,
2148
2149                    max_cards_selected: int = INFINITE,
2150                    max_size: int = INFINITE
2151
2152                    ) -> bool:
2153        """
2154        This creates a mew group with the given variables.
2155        Returns True on success, False on failure.
2156        """
2157
2158        if  not groupname or groupname in list(self.groups.keys()):
2159            return False
2160
2161        if len(self.groups) - 1 >= self.max_group_number:
2162            #create info
2163            self.print_info_text(
2164                                    text_page=RenderableCardListviewer.MAX_GROUP_NUMBER_REACHED_INFO_PAGE,
2165                                    text_color=RenderableCardListviewer.INFO_TEXT_ERROR_COLOR,
2166                                    fade_duration=RenderableCardListviewer.MAX_GROUP_NUMBER_REACHED_FADING_DURATION
2167                                )
2168
2169        if cardlist is None:
2170            cardlist = {}
2171
2172        group: group_t = Cardgroup.create_group(
2173                                                    cardlist=cardlist,
2174                                                    is_copylist=is_copylist,
2175                                                    is_mutable=is_mutable,
2176                                                    is_renamable=is_renamable,
2177                                                    max_cards_selected=max_cards_selected,
2178                                                    max_size=max_size
2179                                                )
2180
2181        self.groups[groupname] = group
2182
2183        return True

2196    def print_info_text(

2201                        ) -> None:
2202        """

2215                                                                        )
2216
2217        self.current_info_text_fadeout_duration = fade_duration
2218        self.info_text_fading_clock.start()

2220    def info_text_tick(self) -> None:
2221        """
2222        Handles the info text updates.
2223        """
2224
2225        percentage = self.info_text_fading_clock.elapsed() / self.current_info_text_fadeout_duration
2226
2227        if percentage >= 1.0:
2228            self.info_text_rendered = None
2229        else:
2230            fade = int((1.0 - percentage) * 255)
2231            self.info_text_surface.set_alpha(fade)

2237    def create_dropdown_menu_dict(self) -> scrollable_tuple_options_t:
2238        """
2239        Creates the tuple options for the own dropdown menu.
2240        """
2241
2242        mdict = {
2243                    ScrollableDropdownMenu.N_OPTIONS_SHOWN_KEY: RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOWN_AMOUNT
2244                }
2245
2246        groups_dict = {(G,): None for G in self.groups.keys() if G != ScrollableDropdownMenu.N_OPTIONS_SHOWN_KEY}
2247        #dropdown dict with all current groups shown
2248
2249        if self.group_feature_state.group_selection_enabled:
2250
2251            selection_groups_dict = groups_dict.copy()
2252            selection_groups_dict[ScrollableDropdownMenu.N_OPTIONS_SHOWN_KEY] = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SELECT_GROUP_OPTIONS_SHOWN_AMOUNT
2253            mdict[RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SELECT_GROUP_OPTION_KEY] = selection_groups_dict
2254
2255        if self.group_feature_state.group_creation_enabled:
2256
2257            mdict[RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.CREATE_GROUP_OPTION_KEY] = None
2258
2259        if self.group_feature_state.group_deletion_enabled:
2260
2261            deletion_group_dict = groups_dict.copy()
2262            deletion_group_dict[ScrollableDropdownMenu.N_OPTIONS_SHOWN_KEY] = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.DELETE_GROUP_OPTIONS_SHOWN_AMOUNT
2263            mdict[RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.DELETE_GROUP_OPTION_KEY] = deletion_group_dict
2264
2265        #sorting types
2266        sorting_options_dict = {
2267                                    RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.RANDOMIZED_SORTING: None,
2268                                    RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_DESCENDING_SORTING: None,
2269                                    RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_ASCENDING_SORTING: None,
2270                                    ScrollableDropdownMenu.N_OPTIONS_SHOWN_KEY: RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SORTING_OPTIONS_SHOWN_AMOUNT
2271                                }
2272
2273        if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
2274
2275            sorting_options_dict[RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_DESCENDING_SORTING] = None
2276            sorting_options_dict[RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_ASCENDING_SORTING] = None
2277
2278        mdict[RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SORTING_OPTION_KEY] = sorting_options_dict
2279
2280        #display types
2281        display_options_dict = {
2282                                    RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_EACH_CARD_DISPLAY_TYPE: None,
2283                                    RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT_DISPLAY_TYPE: None,
2284                                    ScrollableDropdownMenu.N_OPTIONS_SHOWN_KEY: RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.DISPLAY_OPTIONS_SHOWN_AMOUNT
2285                                }
2286
2287        mdict[RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.DISPLAY_TYPE_KEY] = display_options_dict
2288
2289        return mdict

2292    def handle_dropdown_menu_selection(self, event: pygame.event.Event) -> None:
2293        """
2294        Handles actions taken when a event
2295        from the own dropdown menu is received.
2296        """
2297
2298        if event.type == ScrollableDropdownMenu.EventTypes.SELECT_ANIMATION_ENDED:
2299            #selection was done
2300            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2301                #getting the selected instance
2302                full_trace: list[tuple[str]] = event.selected_option_tuples
2303                selection: tuple[str] = full_trace[-1]
2304
2305                if selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.RANDOMIZED_SORTING:
2306                    self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.randomized
2307                    self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2308                    self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2309                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_DESCENDING_SORTING:
2310                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_descending:
2311                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_descending
2312                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2313                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2314                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_ASCENDING_SORTING:
2315                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_ascending:
2316                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_ascending
2317                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2318                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2319                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_DESCENDING_SORTING:
2320                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_descending:
2321                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_descending
2322                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2323                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2324                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_ASCENDING_SORTING:
2325                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_ascending:
2326                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_ascending
2327                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
2328                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2329                #display types
2330                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_EACH_CARD_DISPLAY_TYPE:
2331                    if self.main_list_view_state != RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
2332                        self.main_list_view_state = RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD
2333                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2334
2335                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT_DISPLAY_TYPE:
2336                    if self.main_list_view_state != RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
2337                        self.main_list_view_state = RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT
2338                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
2339
2340                #group selection
2341                elif full_trace[0] == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SELECT_GROUP_OPTION_KEY:
2342
2343                    self.shown_group = selection[0]
2344                    self.reload_current_group()
2345
2346                elif full_trace[0] == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.DELETE_GROUP_OPTION_KEY:
2347
2348                    dgroup = selection[0]
2349                    #initializes group deletion
2350                    if Cardgroup.is_deleteable(group=self.groups[dgroup]):
2351                        self.initialize_group_deletion(group_to_delete=dgroup)
2352                    else:
2353
2354                        self.print_info_text(
2355                                                text_page=RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_UNDELETEABLE_INFO_PAGE,
2356                                                text_color=RenderableCardListviewer.INFO_TEXT_ERROR_COLOR,
2357                                                fade_duration=RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_UNDELETEABLE_FADING_DURATION
2358                                                )
2359
2360                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.CREATE_GROUP_OPTION_KEY:
2361                    self.initialize_deck_creation_frame()
2362

2392    def reload_dropdown_menu_with_progress(self) -> None:
2393        """
2394        Reloads the dropdown menu whilst keeping the
2395        selection state the same.
2396        """
2397        if self.dropdown_menu is not None:
2398
2399            trace: scrollable_option_trace_t = self.dropdown_menu.get_option_trace()
2400            self.create_dropdown_menu()
2401            self.dropdown_menu.select_option_expanded(trace)

2403    #==================================
2404    # TICK FUNCTIONS AND ANIMATION HANDLING
2405    #==================================
2406
2407    def _get_render_signature(self) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
2408        """Return the state values that can change the rendered widget."""
2409        return (
2410            self.state,
2411            self.prev_state,
2412            self.selected_card_index,
2413            self.main_list_yscroll,
2414            self.shown_group,
2415            self.main_list_view_state,
2416            self.is_focused(),
2417            self.info_text_active(),
2418            self.focused_text_input_subframe is not None
2419        )
2420
2421    def _needs_continuous_prerender(self) -> bool:
2422        """Return True while a visual animation or timed effect is running."""
2423        animated_states = (
2424            RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP,
2425            RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN,
2426            RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP,
2427            RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_SELECTED_ANIMATION,
2428            RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_SELECTED_ANIMATION,
2429            RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION,
2430            RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_DELETION_POPUP_SHOWN
2431        )
2432
2433        return (
2434            self.state in animated_states
2435            or (
2436                self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED
2437                and self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2438            )
2439            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE
2440            or self.info_text_active()
2441            or self.focused_text_input_subframe is not None
2442        )
2443
2444    @override
2445    def tick(self) -> None:
2446        """
2447        Tick function.
2448        """
2449
2450        if self.intro_delay_clock.elapsed() >= self.intro_delay:
2451            self.manage_pygame_events()
2452
2453        if self.exit_flag_raised():
2454            return None
2455
2456        if self.is_focused():
2457
2458            """
2459            INFO TEXT
2460            """
2461
2462            if self.info_text_active():
2463                self.info_text_tick()
2464
2465            """
2466            DROPDOWN MENU
2467            """
2468
2469            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2470                self.dropdown_menu.tick()
2471
2472                #dropdown events
2473                dropdown_events = self.dropdown_menu.poll_events()
2474
2475                for event in dropdown_events:
2476                    self.handle_dropdown_menu_selection(event)
2477
2478            """
2479            STATE ACTIONS
2480            """
2481            #non input accepting states
2482            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP:
2483                self.move_one_row_up()
2484            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN:
2485                self.move_one_row_down()
2486            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP:
2487                self.move_all_rows_up()
2488            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN:
2489                if not self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.SHOW_IMAGE_KEY):
2490                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2491            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_SELECTED_ANIMATION:
2492                self.deckname_selected_animation()
2493            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_SELECTED_ANIMATION:
2494                self.menu_button_selected_animation()
2495            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.INITIALIZE_DECK_RENAMING_FRAME:
2496                self.initialize_deck_renaming_frame()
2497            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION:
2498                self.card_snapback_animation()
2499            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED:
2500                if not (self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RETURN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.ENTER_ALTERNATIVE)):
2501                    if self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
2502                        #if a card was focused, we need to animate putting it back in its original state
2503                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION
2504                        self.initialize_card_snapback_animation()
2505                    else:
2506                        self.state = self.prev_state
2507                        if self.enter_clock.elapsed() >= self.time_until_long_enter_pressed:
2508                            self.long_enter_pressed()
2509                        else:
2510                            self.enter_pressed()
2511                        self.key_clock.start()
2512                else:
2513                    if self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
2514                        self.card_pressed_animation()
2515
2516            else:
2517                #accept inputs
2518
2519                if self.key_clock.elapsed() > self.key_delay:
2520
2521                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE):
2522                        self.escape_pressed()
2523                        self.key_clock.start()
2524
2525                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LEFT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.LEFT_ALTERNATIVE):
2526                        self.left_pressed()
2527                        self.key_clock.start()
2528
2529                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RIGHT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.RIGHT_ALTERNATIVE):
2530                        self.right_pressed()
2531                        self.key_clock.start()
2532
2533                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_UP) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.UP_ALTERNATIVE):
2534                        self.up_pressed()
2535                        self.key_clock.start()
2536
2537                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_DOWN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.DOWN_ALTERNATIVE):
2538                        self.down_pressed()
2539                        self.key_clock.start()
2540
2541                    if self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.SHOW_IMAGE_KEY):
2542                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN
2543                        self.prerender_full_image()
2544                        self.key_clock.start()
2545
2546                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RETURN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.ENTER_ALTERNATIVE):
2547
2548                        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
2549                            self.cards_dict_before_enter = self.main_list_cards_dict[self.selected_card_index]
2550                            self.cards_rects_before_enter = self.main_list_cards_rects[self.cards_dict_before_enter[3]]#the cy
2551                            self.cards_rects_before_enter_index = [i for i in range(len(self.cards_rects_before_enter)) if self.cards_rects_before_enter[i][0] == self.selected_card_index][0]
2552                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED
2553                        self.enter_clock.start()
2554                        self.key_clock.start()
2555
2556                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_BACKSPACE) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY):
2557                        self.back_pressed()
2558                        self.key_clock.start()
2559        """
2560        SUBFRAMES ACTIVE
2561        """
2562        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECK_RENAMING_FRAME_ACTIVE:
2563            ret = self.focused_text_input_subframe.tick()
2564
2565            if ret is None:
2566
2567                #setting the groupname
2568                if self.focused_text_input_subframe.exit_with_enter():
2569
2570                    text = self.focused_text_input_subframe.get_input_text()
2571
2572                    if not text or text in list(self.groups.keys()):
2573
2574                        self.print_info_text(
2575                                                text_page=RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS_INFO_PAGE,
2576                                                text_color=RenderableCardListviewer.INFO_TEXT_ERROR_COLOR,
2577                                                fade_duration=RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS_ERROR_FADING_DURATION
2578                                            )
2579
2580                        self.focused_text_input_subframe.reset_exit_flag()
2581                        self.focused_text_input_subframe.reset_exit_type()
2582
2583                    else:
2584
2585                        data_cp = deepcopy(self.groups[self.shown_group])
2586                        del self.groups[self.shown_group]
2587                        self.shown_group = self.focused_text_input_subframe.get_input_text()
2588                        self.groups[self.shown_group] = data_cp
2589                        self.focused_text_input_subframe = None
2590                        self.focus()
2591                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
2592                        self.create_deckname_text()
2593                        self.create_dropdown_menu()
2594
2595                elif self.focused_text_input_subframe.exit_with_escape():
2596                    self.focused_text_input_subframe = None
2597                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
2598
2599                self.focus()
2600
2601                self.key_clock.start()
2602
2603        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECK_CREATION_FRAME_ACTIVE:
2604            ret = self.focused_text_input_subframe.tick()
2605
2606            if ret is None:
2607                self.finalize_deck_creation_frame()
2608
2609        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.GROUP_DELETION_POPUP_SHOWN:
2610
2611            ret: Frame = self.group_deletion_popup.tick()
2612
2613            if ret is None:
2614                self.group_deletion_popup = None
2615                self.group_to_delete = None
2616                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2617
2618            else:
2619
2620                for event in self.group_deletion_popup.poll_events():
2621
2622                    if event.type == Popup.EventTypes.OPTION_SELECTED:
2623
2624                        #checking the option
2625                        if event.option_index == 0:
2626                            #YES
2627                            self.delete_group(self.group_to_delete)
2628
2629                        #normal state
2630                        self.focus()
2631                        self.group_deletion_popup = None
2632
2633                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2634
2635                        self.group_to_delete = None
2636
2637            self.key_clock.start()
2638
2639        # Only redraw when visible state changed, an explicit invalidation was
2640        # raised elsewhere, or a continuously animated element needs a new frame.
2641        render_signature = self._get_render_signature()
2642        if (
2643            render_signature != self._last_render_signature
2644            or self._needs_continuous_prerender()
2645        ):
2646            self.raise_prerender_flag()
2647        self._last_render_signature = render_signature
2648
2649        #prerendering
2650        if self.prerender_flag_raised():
2651            self.prerender()
2652            self.reset_prerender_flag()
2653
2654        return self
2655    """
2656    INTERACTION FUNCTIONS
2657    """
2658
2659    def left_pressed(self):
2660
2661        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
2662            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2663            self.selected_card_index = 0
2664        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
2665            #if we're at the leftmost state, leave the main list focus
2666            if (self.selected_card_index % self.cards_per_line) == 0:
2667                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
2668            else:
2669                self.selected_card_index -= 1
2670        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
2671            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED
2672        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
2673            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
2674        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
2675            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2676        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2677            self.dropdown_menu.move_left()
2678
2679    def right_pressed(self):
2680
2681        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
2682            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2683            self.selected_card_index = 0
2684        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
2685            #if we're at the rightmost state, leave the main list focus
2686            if ((self.selected_card_index + 1) % self.cards_per_line) == 0:
2687                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
2688            else:
2689                self.selected_card_index += 1
2690
2691        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
2692            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
2693        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
2694            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED
2695        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
2696            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2697        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2698            self.dropdown_menu.move_right()
2699
2700    def up_pressed(self):
2701
2702        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
2703            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2704
2705        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED\
2706            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED\
2707            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
2708
2709            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
2710
2711        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
2712
2713            if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
2714                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2715                return
2716
2717            if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LSHIFT):
2718                if not self.fastscroll_enabled:
2719                    self.fastscroll_enabled = True
2720                    self.rowscroll_copy = self.rowscrolling_duration
2721                    self.rowscrolling_duration = self.fastscroll_duration
2722            elif self.fastscroll_enabled:
2723                self.fastscroll_enabled = False
2724                self.rowscrolling_duration = self.rowscroll_copy
2725            #check for going off, and if the index is in rendered rows
2726            if self.selected_card_index < self.cards_per_line:
2727                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2728            elif (self.selected_card_index - self.cards_per_line) not in [x[1] for x in self.rendered_rows]:
2729                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP
2730                self.initialize_move_one_row_up()
2731            else:
2732                self.selected_card_index -= self.cards_per_line
2733
2734        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2735            self.dropdown_menu.move_up()
2736
2737    def down_pressed(self):
2738
2739        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
2740            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
2741
2742        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED\
2743            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED\
2744            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
2745
2746            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
2747            self.selected_card_index = 0
2748            self.main_list_yscroll = 0
2749
2750        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
2751
2752            if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
2753                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
2754                return
2755            #check for going off, and if the index is in rendered rows
2756            if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LSHIFT):
2757                if not self.fastscroll_enabled:
2758                    self.fastscroll_enabled = True
2759                    self.rowscroll_copy = self.rowscrolling_duration
2760                    self.rowscrolling_duration = self.fastscroll_duration
2761            elif self.fastscroll_enabled:
2762                self.fastscroll_enabled = False
2763                self.rowscrolling_duration = self.rowscroll_copy
2764
2765            if self.selected_card_index >= (self.n_cards_shown - self.cards_per_line):
2766                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
2767                self.selected_card_index %= (self.n_cards_shown)
2768                self.selected_card_index -= (self.cards_per_line - self.n_cards_shown % self.cards_per_line)
2769                if self.selected_card_index < self.cards_per_line:
2770                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP
2771                    self.initialize_move_all_rows_up()
2772            elif len(self.rendered_rows) < (self.cards_per_line * self.cards_per_column):
2773                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
2774                self.selected_card_index %= self.n_cards_shown
2775            elif (self.selected_card_index + self.cards_per_line) not in [x[1] for x in self.rendered_rows]:
2776
2777                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN
2778                self.initialize_move_one_row_down()
2779            else:
2780                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
2781
2782        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
2783            self.dropdown_menu.move_down()
2784
